text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen is here. Everyone is focused on the upcoming showdown between Agnes Tachyon and Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has the fruits of her research, the support of her fans, and the motivation to beat her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With all the reagents necessary to reach the limits of Umamusume potential, Agnes Tachyon is ready for the Arima Kinen!
